starter_questions: How can I try the included dilution series?
What should my Markdown procedure include?
Why did the last procedure adapt or stop?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll turn your Markdown lab procedure into a PyLabRobot simulation and explain each tracked operation. Start with the included synthetic dilution series, then provide your own procedure. This co-worker operates simulated liquid handling only.

sample.title: Synthetic dilution series with reserve-source recovery
sample.description: Watch an 18-step, three-plate procedure with reserve-source recovery, split transfers, serial mixing and readout aliquots.
sample.expected_output: Live operations on the deck, six volume checks, ten final goals and a saved replay.

real.introduction: Supply your own Markdown procedure for simulation. Physical lab equipment is outside this blueprint.

fields.label: Lab procedure
fields.description: Paste Markdown with explicit starting volumes, numbered steps and final goals. Clear the procedure file when using text.

fields.label: Procedure file
fields.description: Select a .md file instead of pasting text.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording; revise the Markdown and start a new run to change the procedure.

web_ui.title: Web lab
web_ui.description: Open the empty PyLabRobot deck during planning, watch the simulation, then review the saved replay.
